explanation: This module translates the core Apache Commons CLI 1.9.0 library components specified in the contract (Option, Options, OptionGroup, CommandLine, DefaultParser, and exceptions ParseException, UnrecognizedOptionException, AmbiguousOptionException, MissingArgumentException, MissingOptionException, AlreadySelectedException). It implements Option validation, token-level parsing, option grouping, option cloning during command-line processing, partial long option matching, concatenated options handling, and required options/groups tracking while adhering to Python conventions and standard library requirements.
